stories.summary: Researchers assess the effectiveness of large language models in grammar engineering, introducing Cantonese ParGram resources and comparing performance against English benchmarks. The controlled evaluation highlights strengths and limitations of LLMs in linguistic applications.

stories.summary: Researchers unveil LongWoF-Bench, a benchmark designed to assess AI models' ability to handle verifiable, multi-step workflows using EvoMap genes. The tool aims to improve reliability in complex, long-horizon decision-making systems.
stories.title: LongWoF-Bench Introduces Framework for Evaluating AI in Long-Workflow Tasks

stories.summary: Researchers introduced ChebBooster, a training-free technique that accelerates diffusion transformer inference by applying Chebyshev-inspired extrapolation to model activations. The approach delivers substantial speedups without extra training, improving efficiency for diffusion‑based AI generation tasks.
stories.title: ChebBooster Enables Training-Free, Faster Diffusion Transformer Inference Using Chebyshev Extrapolation

stories.summary: Researchers have developed AI models capable of deeply analyzing basketball games, including player movements, strategies, and outcomes. The breakthrough aims to enhance coaching, scouting, and fan engagement through data-driven insights.
stories.title: AI Advances in Comprehensive Basketball Understanding

stories.summary: Researchers have released EG-ARSA, an open‑source visual auditing system that leverages expert‑derived criteria to evaluate road safety from imagery. Designed for low‑resource settings, the model aims to automate inspections, accelerate hazard detection, and support safer infrastructure planning.
stories.title: Open AI Model EG-ARSA Enables Expert‑Grounded Visual Road Safety Audits in Low‑Resource Environments

stories.summary: Researchers developed an AI system that analyzes surgical team interactions and provides interpretable, actionable suggestions by modeling counterfactual scenarios. The approach leverages multimodal data to enhance teamwork and decision-making in operating rooms.
stories.title: AI Model Uses Counterfactual Analysis to Improve Surgical Team Dynamics

stories.summary: Researchers introduce a novel methodology to evaluate AI models with rigorous statistical guarantees, aiming to improve transparency and reliability across deployments. The approach, dubbed “Credible Measurement,” combines Bayesian inference with robust validation to address current gaps in AI evaluation.
stories.title: New Framework Promises Credible Measurement and Inference for AI Systems

stories.summary: Researchers introduced a prompt‑authority control mechanism that dynamically routes inputs to a heavyweight slow‑path module only for challenging vision‑language‑action tasks, reducing unnecessary computation. Experiments show the approach maintains performance while cutting inference cost by up to 40 %.
stories.title: Prompt-Authority Framework Lets Vision‑Language‑Action Models Invoke Slow‑Path Processing Only When Needed

stories.summary: Researchers unveiled ReWorld, a new AI world model that can maintain and reason over extended temporal contexts, enabling more coherent long‑term planning and interaction. The system leverages a novel memory architecture to store and retrieve information across long horizons, pushing forward capabilities in simulation and decision‑making tasks.
stories.title: ReWorld introduces an interactive world model with long‑horizon memory

stories.summary: A recent survey of computer science researchers reveals that while there is a strong expectation for transparent AI disclosure in academic papers, actual practices often fall short. The authors call for clearer community guidelines and standardized reporting to improve reproducibility and ethical oversight.
stories.title: Study Finds Gaps Between Expected and Actual AI Disclosure Practices in Computer Science Research
Same Agent, Different Answers: A Repeat-Aware Audit of Corpus-Induced Answer Churn in Retrieval-Augmented QA

stories.summary: Researchers examined the impact of deliberately poisoned training data on anomaly‑detection algorithms used in industrial control systems, testing multiple models under realistic contamination scenarios. The findings reveal that while some detection methods retain high accuracy, others suffer severe performance drops, underscoring the importance of designing more resilient training pipelines.
stories.title: Study Evaluates Robustness of Anomaly Detection Models for Industrial Control Systems Against Training‑Time Data Contamination

stories.summary: Researchers introduced Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a novel training framework that enables agents to evaluate and refine their own decisions over extended horizons. Benchmarks demonstrate that SRPO markedly improves performance on complex reasoning tasks compared to previous approaches.
stories.title: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization Enhances Long-Horizon Reasoning in AI Agents

stories.summary: Meta AI unveiled MetaCaster, an agent that leverages a meta‑harness to perform end‑to‑end few‑shot training of compact time‑series forecasting models, enabling rapid adaptation with minimal data. Benchmarks show the approach outperforms existing lightweight forecasters on standard datasets, highlighting its potential for real‑time forecasting applications.

The update adds larger memory buffers, advanced planning modules, and tighter integration tools designed to boost enterprise productivity.
stories.title: Apodex 1.1 Launches to Scale Agentic Intelligence for Complex Tasks

stories.summary: A new study introduces InjecMEM, a technique that injects malicious data into the external memory modules of large language model agents, allowing attackers to manipulate the agents' behavior and outputs. The findings expose a critical vulnerability in LLM-powered autonomous systems and call for robust memory‑safety safeguards.
